column1: # Pinned upstream downloads for the offline runtime archive.
# Summary: every file `scripts/archive_runtimes.sh` downloads from the internet (other than
# Python wheels, which are pinned by uv.lock), with the sha256 it must have. The script
# refuses any download whose hash differs.
# Format: tab-separated `path  sha256  url`. `path` is relative to the archive's
# `runtimes/` folder. Lines starting with `#` are comments.
# Where each hash comes from:
# - uv, cmake and python-build-standalone files: the sha256 digest GitHub publishes for
#   each release asset (checked 2026-11-23).
# - llama-ui dist: the dist.tar.gz.sha256 file published next to it (matched).
# - llama.cpp source, CPython source: no upstream hash found; recorded from our own
#   download on 2026-11-23 (trust on first use). GitHub-generated source tarballs can
#   change bytes over time; if a re-download mismatches, compare contents before trusting.
# Targets: macos-arm64 (this Mac), macos-x86_64 (2012 MacBook Air), linux-aarch64
# (Raspberry Pi 4/5), linux-armv6 (original Raspberry Pi Model B). See docs/OFFLINE.md.
# llama.cpp at the exact build the catalog was checked against (build 12359, commit b1b770d9)
sources/llama.cpp-b12359-b1b770d9.tar.gz
# Prebuilt web UI for llama-server; the build would otherwise download it
sources/llama-ui-b12359-dist.tar.gz
# CPython source: only needed where no prebuilt Python exists (original Pi)
sources/Python-3.12.15.tgz
# cmake 4.4.3: source (builds anywhere with a C++ compiler) and prebuilt binaries
sources/cmake-4.4.3.tar.gz
cmake/cmake-4.4.3-macos-universal.tar.gz
cmake/cmake-4.4.3-macos10.10-universal.tar.gz
cmake/cmake-4.4.3-linux-aarch64.tar.gz
# uv 0.13.0 (the version this repo's uv.lock was made with)
uv/uv-0.13.0-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
uv/uv-0.13.0-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
uv/uv-0.13.0-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
uv/uv-0.13.0-arm-unknown-linux-musleabihf.tar.gz
# Python 3.12.15, prebuilt (python-build-standalone 20261009); none exists for ARMv6
python/cpython-3.12.15-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
python/cpython-3.12.15-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
python/cpython-3.12.15-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
